notes: v1.0.36 fixes the remaining icon-quality issues from v1.0.35: switches the icon source from raster (wordmark-master.png) to vector (asa-wordmark-master.svg + asa-glyph-s.svg) so every output size is rasterized fresh with 4x supersample + LANCZOS downscale (no raster re-resampling); unifies the brand green to phosphor #5FFF7E across light and dark themes (was forest #0A4F2C in light); restores the multi-shade folded-S detail at icon sizes >=64 (phosphor base + dark fold accents in S-flow direction + lighter highlight strips); centres the glyph in its canvas at every output size (verified L/R T/B margins symmetric within +/-1px). No functional changes for the trading engine. Same Tauri identifier as v1.0.30->v1.0.35, so v1.0.35 users update via the in-app updater.
